description: What the owner sent you in this project (pictures, PDFs, Word files, text, recordings, videos), read from where it was saved. With no id: every file they sent, the newest first, each with its id, name, kind, where it was saved and whether it was read. With an id: that file whole, with its words or transcript. A message's own files are already in input.attached; read here what they sent earlier. Free.

id.description: a file's id, or null for the list

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: attachment_read
title: Attachment read
